_comment: S2S bring-up profile. Select with `CodeReviewDaemon --review s2s`. Runs the review INSIDE a separate LmStreaming.Sample review host (http://localhost:5051) over the S2S REST API instead of an in-process agent loop, so the posted comment can deep-link the real conversation + its code-reviewer:* sub-agent tree. Deliberately isolated from the live poster profile (appsettings.achieveai.json): its own port, DB, log and conversation store, so the two never share state. SECRET: LmStreamingS2SSecret is NOT stored here — pass it as env CodeReviewDaemon__LmStreamingS2SSecret, matching the review host's Auth__S2SInboundSecret. Shared-gateway invariant: SandboxGateway:WorkspaceBasePath must equal the gateway's WORKSPACE_BASE_HOST_PATH, and PerAppWorkspaceRooting+AppId must match what the daemon forwards as X-Sbx-App-Id, so the leaf the preparer clones into is the leaf the gateway mounts.

Github._comment: GitHub CLI (gh) first-party OAuth App id + secret (public, safe to embed — same convention as appsettings.achieveai.json). Lets the auth-webhook inject the stored token for the review agent's api.github.com calls.

CodeReviewDaemon._LmStreamingProviderId_comment: Provision carries no model field — the model is whatever this LmStreaming provider resolves. gpt-5.6-luna mirrors the achieveai profile's ReviewModelId and is a Copilot-backed (non-CLI) provider, which workspace-agent mode requires.
CodeReviewDaemon._EnableToolAssistedReview_comment: OFF on the S2S path: the sandbox/tooling now lives inside the LmStreaming-hosted conversation, so the daemon does not provision its own review sandbox or pooled slot. The daemon still computes the bounded diff it sends as the review input.
CodeReviewDaemon._MaxPrAgeDays_comment: Scopes this bring-up to the single recent PR under test (#222); the other open PRs are weeks older and fall outside the window.
